paragraphs: Shishna. Rav Dimi bar Shishna, Gittin 62a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Gittin 62a follows סב. under the period convention, without independent edition-specific verification.

This notice has שישנא, Shishna, and 62a. The separate Shashna notice has ששנא and 62b. These supplied forms and locators are not harmonized. Rav Dimi’s full רב is preserved; no further biography is supplied.
